name: dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.recommendations
title: Catalog Recommendations
description: Extends Catalog Search with anchored retrieval purposes: items similar to, complementary to, or substitutes for the anchors the Platform names in `references`. Responses reuse the Catalog Search response unchanged.

purpose_policy.title: Purpose Policy
purpose_policy.description: Policy for one supported `purpose` value. An empty object means the value is supported with no advertised limits.

max_references.description: Maximum distinct `references` the Business processes for this purpose. When a request carries more, the Business processes the first `max_references` distinct references in request order and includes an informational `batch_limit_applied` message. Does not apply to `substitute`, which always takes exactly one.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: One anchor for the request. Carries exactly one anchor kind. This extension defines `id`; other extensions MAY define additional anchor kinds as additional properties. A Business that does not recognize a reference's anchor kind drops it and SHOULD include an informational `unsupported_reference` message.

id.description: Product or variant identifier. Resolution follows Catalog Lookup's supported identifiers.

purposes.description: Supported `purpose` values, keyed by value (e.g., `similar`, `complementary`, `substitute`). A Platform MUST NOT send a `purpose` value other than `search` that is absent from this map. `search` is always supported by Catalog Search and is not listed.

recommendations_search_request.title: Catalog Search Request with Recommendations
recommendations_search_request.description: Catalog search request extended with an anchored retrieval purpose.

purpose.description: Retrieval purpose. Well-known values: `search` (default when omitted), `similar`, `complementary`, `substitute`. A Platform MUST NOT send a value other than `search` unless the Business lists it in `config.purposes`. A Business MUST NOT ignore `purpose`; it rejects a value it does not support (error code `unsupported_purpose`).

references.description: Anchors for the request. Anchors are never returned. Ignored when `purpose` is `search` or omitted.
Anchors the results resemble. Multiple references form one joint anchor set; results need not resemble every anchor.
Anchors the results go with (for example, a product being viewed or the lines of a cart). Multiple references form one joint anchor set. The product of every catalog anchor is excluded from results.

Exactly one catalog item being replaced, named by `id`. It MUST resolve to one product or variant; otherwise the Business returns an `ambiguous_reference` error. Its attributes guide relevance and are not matching constraints.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with recommendations (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

platform_schema.title: Catalog Recommendations (Platform)
platform_schema.description: Platform declaration for catalog recommendations. No platform config is required.

business_schema.title: Catalog Recommendations (Business)
business_schema.description: Business declaration for catalog recommendations. Businesses list the purposes they support in `config.purposes`.
